structured_output.summary: Stop defaulting a missing transaction_date to the UTC calendar day. With no persisted user timezone, the server cannot derive the correct local date, so the POST route now returns 400 when transaction_date is missing or not a YYYY-MM-DD string. The existing client already sends transaction_date. The insert, amount validation and default-category lookup are unchanged. Nothing was run or tested.

edits.old: // Look up the user's default category instead of hardcoding 1
edits.new:
if (typeof transaction_date !== 'string' || !/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(transaction_date)) return c.json({ error: 'transaction_date is required (YYYY-MM-DD, client local date)' }, 400)
